title: Gilany's Retextures
description: A Cool Little Texture Pack I Made For Fun
body:
### **Gilany's Retextures :3**
A texture pack i **made for fun**
### 
It changes some GUI and Block textures.

**Remember its still in works so you shouldnt expect much stuff**

I'll update this pack _whenever i feel like it_ cuz it was made for fun :3

### Supports

"[The Broken Script](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-broken-script)'s" Moon Phases, cuz yeah i play the mod..) 

"[Biomes O Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty)'s" Textures

### CREDITS / INSPIRATIONS

**ALL** Dirt And Grass Textures **Inspired** By [This Texture Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-dirt) (By Napino)

Sun and Moon Textures **Inspired** By [This Texture Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sun-and-moon-paw) (By rnky)

Heart Textures **Inspired** By [This Texture Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark)
(By amongstreality)
